purpose_definitions.transparent_forwarding_mechanism_proof: Can an exact call be wrapped and forwarded once without changing guest-visible behaviour?
purpose_definitions.presentation_frame_correlation: Can title swap/frame identity be joined to mailbox and host Present without claiming draw provenance?
purpose_definitions.draw_resource_defect_diagnosis: Does the boundary retain enough draw, register, shader, binding, texture, EDRAM and outcome state to discriminate a defect?
purpose_definitions.eventual_renderer_replacement: Could the boundary express and own renderer operations without recreating the entire GPU ABI or creating dual ownership?

inputs: Object-like r3 and queue-owned state; exact ABI unknown.
outputs: Consumes or advances one or more async queues; exact result unknown.
persistent_state: Lionhead queues, synchronization and ownership are unresolved.
boundaries.threading: Unknown Lionhead worker/queue context; queue thread, producer threads and re-entry are not statically proved.
semantics_retained: Potential Lionhead command grouping and queue timing label.
semantics_lost: Static Xbox D3D method identities and packet-level outcomes remain unknown.
existing_fable_evidence: exact TU1 generated ReXGlue body: 209 PPC instructions
TU1 string reference at 0x82AAC254 to ProcessAsyncCommandQueues timing label
side_effects: May consume multiple queues, mutate queue ownership, signal synchronization, or recurse into Xbox graphics methods. Hook only after thread/order behaviour is traced.
boundaries.forwarding_feasibility: conditional
boundaries.observation_value: A proven semantic command ABI could preserve title intent, but no command layouts are known.
boundaries.replacement_value: Potentially valuable only after static ABI, threading and coverage proof.
boundaries.evidence_required: The title-owned diagnostic label identifies queue processing; no evidence yet proves this function is the enqueue boundary or that commands preserve D3D semantics.

transparent_forwarding_mechanism_proof.rationale: Queue ABI, ownership, threading, recursion and coverage are unproved.

presentation_frame_correlation.rationale: The queue has no confirmed one-command-per-frame or present mapping.

draw_resource_defect_diagnosis.rationale: A proven semantic command ABI could preserve title intent, but no command layouts are known.

eventual_renderer_replacement.rationale: Potentially valuable only after static ABI, threading and coverage proof.
